title: GitHub restructures bug bounty program following flood of AI-generated reports
excerpt: GitHub now has a public and a private bug bounty scheme
content_html:
• GitHub to launch two-tier (public and private) bug bounty schemes form July 27 2026
  • Change comes in response to rise in lower-quality, AI-generated reports
  • VIP researchers will earn around 3-4x more per report

GitHub has confirmed plans to evolve its bug bounty program into a two-tier system, which will come into force for reports submitted on or after July 27, 2026.

Under the new scheme, the Microsoft-owned coding platform will add a lower-paying public program that's available to the wider research community, under a higher-paying invitation-only program.

Product Security Engineer Catherine Cassell explained that the change comes in response to a growing backlog of low-effort, low-quality and AI-generated reports.

GitHub complains about AI-generated bug reports

For the new public program, GitHub will replace payout ranges with a single payment for each severity, spanning $250, $2,000, $5,000 and $10,000 for low, medium, high and critical. Cassell said this would help researchers know in advance what a valid finding could be worth, and it would also give insiders less of a headache having to decide where a report sits within a range.

Notably, the payouts are much lower than before, with the previous ranges paying out $500-$1,000, $2,000-$5,000, $5,000-$20,000 and $10,000-$30,000.

Invited VIP researchers under the second plan will earn around 3-4x more than researchers under the other scheme, depending on bug severity.

GitHub is also adding a HackerOne signal requirement for new researchers, giving them four opportunities to "establish a track record" – likely another response to rising AI-generated reports, which are typically of lower value.

content_html_zh:
• GitHub 将于 2026 年 7 月 27 日起推出两级（公共和私人）错误赏金计划
  • 变化是为了应对人工智能生成的低质量报告的增加
  • VIP 研究人员每份报告的收入将增加约 3-4 倍

GitHub 已确认计划将其错误赏金计划发展为两层系统，该系统将对 2026 年 7 月 27 日或之后提交的报告生效。

根据新计划，微软旗下的编码平台将在高薪邀请计划下添加一项低薪公共计划，供更广泛的研究社区使用。

产品安全工程师凯瑟琳·卡塞尔 (Catherine Cassell) 解释说，这一变化是为了应对日益积压的低工作量、低质量和人工智能生成的报告。

GitHub 抱怨人工智能生成的错误报告

对于新的公共计划，GitHub 将针对每种严重程度将支付范围改为一次支付，涵盖低、中、高和严重的 250 美元、2,000 美元、5,000 美元和 10,000 美元。 卡塞尔表示，这将有助于研究人员提前了解有效发现的价值，而且还可以让内部人士减少因决定报告在某个范围内的位置而感到头疼的问题。

值得注意的是，奖金比以前低得多，之前的奖金范围为 500-1,000 美元、2,000-5,000 美元、5,000-20,000 美元和 10,000-30,000 美元。

根据第二个计划，受邀 VIP 研究人员的收入将比其他计划的研究人员高出约 3-4 倍，具体取决于错误的严重程度。

GitHub 还为新研究人员添加了 HackerOne 信号要求，为他们提供了四个“建立跟踪记录”的机会——这可能是对人工智能生成的报告不断增加的另一种回应，这些报告通常价值较低。
